purpose: Prospective independent public-video evaluation of existing behavior; no source/default/threshold or historical-evidence change

inference.blockedUntil: immutable AI visual annotation/final-set freeze and privacy check

labelAuthority.authorizationEvidence: Explicit user clarification relayed by parent: AI visual review may proceed without waiting for human labeling; freeze before inference; preliminary diagnostics only; human validation required before acceptance

cohort.allowedDerivative: contiguous trim preserving decoded pixels and cadence; no mirror/splice/repeated frames/retime

physicalGate.coordinateSystem: unmirrored top-left image coordinates; anatomical sides
physicalGate.jointRegions: independently annotated plausible uncertainty regions, not model predictions
physicalGate.certification: all permissible joint configurations agree; otherwise allowed gate set or unknown
physicalGate.occludedJoint: unknown, never imputed from a model or treated as transition

modelAdmission.noObservation: no-person / no-pose diagnostic distinct from physical absence
modelAdmission.fullGlobalScore: 0.65 task-admission lower bound; not exposed global detector score
modelAdmission.separateRawVisibilityPresence: record only if actually exposed and retained; never reconstruct from min

androidMoveNet.existingRoute: Android NativeMoveNet through LiteRT; no existing Mac MoveNet backend
androidMoveNet.mapping: current crop transform to decoded source image
androidMoveNet.invalidPoint: (0,0,0), preserve mapping-invalid evidence; not usable confidence-free geometry
androidMoveNet.observationConfidence: minimum of the four raw joint scores
androidMoveNet.classificationPerStatelessImage: three same-image inference passes, last observation classified once

classifier.cooldownBlockedHold: clear, not backdated; arming may survive
classifier.transitionPreservesArmedOnly: expected wrist transition AND opposite down

deterministicClock.VFRPolicy: exclude before prediction; no clock change
deterministicClock.firstEligibleSample: first i with int(t_i-t_start)>=350, subject to arming/cooldown/reset

eventTiming.onsetRepresentation: last definitely non-up sample, first definitely up sample, allowed gates between; not exact physical onset
eventTiming.possibleEligibility: earliest allowed sampled emission under consistent physical observations and existing state rules
eventTiming.guaranteedEligibility: first sampled time at which every permitted physical/state interpretation establishes eligibility; unknown if not provable
eventTiming.beforePossible: definitely early only if no permitted interpretation allows event
eventTiming.betweenPossibleAndGuaranteed: timing-indeterminate; neither definite pass nor proven false trigger
eventTiming.lateBudgetRule: none introduced; any future product budget must be justified and frozen before prediction
eventTiming.outsideSupport: outside opportunity; physical false classification requires independently adjudicable subsequent state
eventTiming.legacyVerifier: ordinal inclusive exact-count eventWindows; raw result preserved; does not implement uncertainty analysis

transport.serviceClock: monotonic milliseconds in actual worker; deterministic file clock only in verifier
transport.actualVideoWorker: no skipping; schedule max(previous+1/fps,monotonic now), slow inference stretches replay
transport.sameRoundRevisionOrLeaseReset: ACK first, then clear temporal/queued work and restore ack_expected
transport.newRoundSequenceNumbers: monotonic across rounds within service, not necessarily restarting1

browser.eventAge: server age + full browser request duration + browser wait since receipt
browser.staleInactiveCompletedReplay: do not consume seq or ray

androidNativeRecordedFile.worker: serialized decoder/crop/interpreter ownership; stale epoch work discarded

ui.timer: 30 seconds of RAF accumulation, each delta capped at250ms; not strict elapsed walltime
ui.pause: timer stops; scored count/lastSeq retained; sidecar fresh neutral needed
ui.sixRays: active input/scoring stops immediately; celebration waits timer end

metrics.unit: unique events and frozen opportunities; correlated frames/derivatives not independent samples
metrics.primaryRecallLower: definite correct ordered timed matches / all frozen definite physical opportunities, including abstention and failed/censored execution
metrics.recallUpper: lower successes plus disjoint possibly compatible or unevaluated opportunities / same denominator; explicit bound, not measured success
metrics.timingIndeterminateEmissions: separate count, not erased or forced to pass/false
metrics.definiteFalseTriggerCount: unique emitted events incompatible with every permitted physical/state interpretation
metrics.falseTriggersPerNegativeMinute: only definite false events occurring inside frozen certified-negative intervals / those intervals in minutes
metrics.geometry: valid predicted-joint gate agreement and admission-conditioned agreement separately; annotation coverage and missing predictions reported
metrics.fullGoal: natural independent exact six-alternation expectation, timed emissions,6rays,ACK consistency and actual UI evidence
metrics.generalizationClaim: bounded pilot only; no camera/FireTV/deployment/general FPR claim

annotation.labelProvenance: AI visual review; not human-, user-supplied or user-approved labels

comparisonRoutes.full: existing Mac Python CPU IMAGE route

scope: Preliminary AI visual diagnostic comparison, not human-confirmed acceptance
